contract.source: action/flange_pose (sent command, lead-limited) at the last robot-loop row before tau_{k+1}
contract.reference: robot/flange_pose measured at the latest robot sample <= tau_k (observation time)
contract.frame: panda_link0 base frame (+x forward, +y left, +z up); left increment R_goal = exp(r) R_k
contract.gripper: action/gripper closure c (0 open .. 1 closed), Robotiq register = 3 + 227 c; policy g = 2c - 1
contract.normalisation: a_norm = [dp / pos_scale_m, r / rot_scale_rad, 2c - 1]; scales from the recorder's teleop limits (max_position_lead + max_linear_speed * max_step_s, rad(max_rotation_lead_deg) + max_angular_speed * max_step_s), max_step_s = 1.5 nominal frame periods
contract.proprio: [flange xyz (m, base), R[:, 0], R[:, 1] (6D), measured gripper closure (register - 3) / 227]
